plans.name: Standard
plans.highlights: Manage up to 10 social media accounts from one calendar.

plans.name: Professional
plans.highlights: Everything in Standard, plus: Manage unlimited social accounts; Automate inbox replies and workflows; Forecast trends up to 90 days ahead; Build custom performance reports.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.highlights: Everything in Professional, plus: Review and approve content with your team; Assign and auto-route messages to the right team members; Measure team performance and efficiency.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.highlights: Everything in Advanced, plus: Advanced analytics, advanced listening, and custom compliance solutions with SSO.
